about.text: The whey that drains from curd set with rennet, in making most cheeses and rennet casein: only mildly acidic, at pH 5.9 to 6.6, and carrying the milk's sugar, its whey proteins and its minerals. About half of processed whey solids now go into whey protein concentrates, isolates, lactose and permeate.

how.text: Rennet sets the casein but leaves the whey proteins in solution, so the liquid that drains off keeps nearly all the milk's lactose and whey protein and is only mildly acidic. Little acid has formed, so the whey proteins and the caseinomacropeptide stay intact, which is why this whey is the starting point for most whey products.
